pregnancy-early-sac.title: Intrauterine gestational sac at 7 weeks
pregnancy-early-sac.label: Transvaginal gestational sac
pregnancy-early-sac.credit: Venkatesh A. Murugan et al., Fig. 7D, Ultrasonography (2020) · © Korean Society of Ultrasound in Medicine
pregnancy-early-sac.reason: Find the dark sac within uterine tissue and the embryo along the sac margin.
pregnancy-early-sac.note: The original crown–rump calipers belong to the acquired image. The source describes serial scans after a symptomatic presentation. This comparison uses the appearance at the named visit. Acquisition approach and magnification differ from the modeled transabdominal scan. Published panel cropped and converted to lossless WebP for noncommercial teaching.

pregnancy-early-crl.title: Yolk sac beside the measured embryo
pregnancy-early-crl.label: Transvaginal yolk sac and crown–rump length
pregnancy-early-crl.credit: Venkatesh A. Murugan et al., Fig. 7A, Ultrasonography (2020) · © Korean Society of Ultrasound in Medicine
pregnancy-early-crl.reason: Find the bright yolk-sac ring below the embryo and follow the two calipers across the embryo.
pregnancy-early-crl.note: The yolk sac and embryo appear in the same section. The original calipers span the embryo. The source describes serial scans after a symptomatic presentation. This comparison uses the appearance at the named visit. Acquisition approach and magnification differ from the modeled transabdominal scan. Published panel cropped and converted to lossless WebP for noncommercial teaching.

pregnancy-early-cardiac.title: Acquired M-mode trace at 7 weeks
pregnancy-early-cardiac.label: Transvaginal embryonic cardiac activity
pregnancy-early-cardiac.credit: Venkatesh A. Murugan et al., Fig. 7E, Ultrasonography (2020) · © Korean Society of Ultrasound in Medicine
pregnancy-early-cardiac.reason: Follow the sampling line through the embryo in the upper image and its motion over time in the strip below.
pregnancy-early-cardiac.note: The trace records 144 bpm in this case. The modeled section localizes the cardiac region in static anatomy. The source describes serial scans after a symptomatic presentation. This comparison uses the appearance at the named visit. Acquisition approach and magnification differ from the modeled transabdominal scan. Published panel cropped and converted to lossless WebP for noncommercial teaching.
